provision.label: (a)
provision.text: Basic entitlement. “A member of an armed force is entitled to leave at the rate of 2½ calendar days for each month of active service, excluding periods of-”

provision.label: (b)
provision.text: Accumulation limits - 60-day cap on accumulated leave.

provision.label: (e)
provision.text: Excess leave retention - Secretary may authorize retention of up to 30 days excess leave.

provision.label: (h)
provision.text: Parental leave. “Under regulations prescribed by the Secretary of Defense, a member of the armed forces described in paragraph (2) is allowed up to a total of 12 weeks of parental leave during the one-year period beginning after” specified events including birth, adoption, and foster placement.

provision.label: (l)
provision.text: Bereavement leave - two weeks for immediate family death.
